title: Pdfding
descript: Pdfding packaged for TerraMaster TOS 7. It runs the official Docker Hub image inside a container on your NAS, keeps all of its data in an application data folder (so it survives restarts and updates), and is opened from its desktop icon.
important: First run: open the web UI and complete the initial setup. Data lives in /Volume1/DockerAppData/pdfdingdocker/ and survives restarts and updates. The container runs as uid 1000, so mounted folders must be readable by that user. Needs DockerEngine; configure a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Back up the application data folder before uninstalling with data removal. Plain HTTP on the LAN.

zh-cn.descript: PDF 管理与标注工具，支持标签、搜索和多用户。
zh-cn.important: 首次使用请打开网页完成初始化。数据保存在 DockerAppData/pdfdingdocker，重启和升级不会丢失。容器以 uid 1000 运行，挂载目录需对该用户可读。需要 DockerEngine；Docker Hub 不可达时先配置镜像加速。卸载并删除数据前请备份。局域网内为 HTTP。
